```{r}
extract_year <- function(x) {
  str_extract(x, "^\\d{4}")
}

extract_brand <- function(x) {
  str_extract(x, "(?<=^\\d{4} )[^ ]+")
}

extract_model <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_remove("^\\d{4}\\s+") %>%
    str_remove("^[^ ]+\\s+") %>%
    str_squish()
}

x <- "2023 Honda BR-V 1.5 Prestige SUV"

extract_year(x)
extract_brand(x)
extract_model(x)
```

```{r}
scrape_page <- function(page_number) {
  
  cat("Scraping halaman:", page_number, "\n")
  
  # URL halaman
  url <- paste0(
    "https://www.carmudi.co.id/mobil-bekas-dijual/indonesia",
    "?page_number=", page_number,
    "&page_size=25"
  )
  
  # Ambil halaman
  halaman <- read_html(url)
  
  # ==============================
  # AMBIL JUDUL
  # ==============================
  
  titles <- halaman %>%
    html_elements("h2") %>%
    html_text2() %>%
    str_squish()
  
  # Hanya ambil judul yang diawali tahun
  titles <- titles[
    str_detect(titles, "^\\d{4}\\s")
  ]
  
  # Kalau tidak ada data
  if (length(titles) == 0) {
    cat("Tidak ada listing di halaman", page_number, "\n")
    return(data.frame())
  }
  
  cat("Jumlah listing:", length(titles), "\n")
  
  
  # ==============================
  # AMBIL SEMUA TEXT HALAMAN
  # ==============================
  
  teks <- halaman %>%
    html_text2() %>%
    str_squish()
  
  
  # ==============================
  # EKSTRAK TAHUN
  # ==============================
  
  year <- str_extract(
    titles,
    "^\\d{4}"
  )
  
  
  # ==============================
  # EKSTRAK BRAND
  # ==============================
  
  brand <- str_extract(
    titles,
    "(?<=^\\d{4}\\s)[A-Za-zÀ-ÿ-]+"
  )
  
  
  # ==============================
  # EKSTRAK MODEL
  # ==============================
  
  model <- titles %>%
    str_remove("^\\d{4}\\s+") %>%
    str_remove("^[A-Za-zÀ-ÿ-]+\\s+") %>%
    str_squish()
  
  
  # ==============================
  # BUAT DATAFRAME DASAR
  # ==============================
  
  data <- data.frame(
    title = titles,
    year = year,
    brand = brand,
    model = model,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  
  # ==============================
  # AMBIL DATA DARI SETIAP LISTING
  # ==============================
  
  # Cari parent/container dari setiap judul
  title_nodes <- halaman %>%
    html_elements("h2") %>%
    .[str_detect(html_text2(.), "^\\d{4}\\s")]
  
  
  price <- character(length(titles))
  mileage <- character(length(titles))
  transmission <- character(length(titles))
  location <- character(length(titles))
  seller_type <- character(length(titles))
  listing_url <- character(length(titles))
  
  
  for (i in seq_along(title_nodes)) {
    
    node <- title_nodes[[i]]
    
    # Ambil container listing
    container <- node
    
    # Naik beberapa level sampai mendapat informasi listing
    for (j in 1:6) {
      
      parent <- xml_parent(container)
      
      if (length(parent) == 0) {
        break
      }
      
      parent_text <- parent %>%
        html_text2() %>%
        str_squish()
      
      # Container yang cukup besar biasanya sudah berisi
      # harga + KM + transmisi + lokasi
      if (
        str_detect(parent_text, "Rp\\s*[0-9]") &&
        (
          str_detect(parent_text, "KM") ||
          str_detect(parent_text, "Automatic") ||
          str_detect(parent_text, "Manual")
        )
      ) {
        container <- parent
        break
      }
      
      container <- parent
    }
    
    
    txt <- container %>%
      html_text2() %>%
      str_squish()
    
    
    # ==========================
    # PRICE
    # ==========================
    
    price[i] <- str_extract(
      txt,
      "Rp\\s*[0-9\\.]+"
    )
    
    
    # ==========================
    # MILEAGE
    # ==========================
    
    mileage[i] <- str_extract(
      txt,
      "[0-9]+\\s*-\\s*[0-9]+K\\s*KM|[0-9]+K\\s*KM|[0-9]+\\s*KM"
    )
    
    
    # ==========================
    # TRANSMISSION
    # ==========================
    
    transmission[i] <- str_extract(
      txt,
      "\\b(Automatic|Manual)\\b"
    )
    
    
    # ==========================
    # LOCATION
    # ==========================
    
    lokasi_list <- c(
      "DKI Jakarta",
      "Banten",
      "Jawa Barat",
      "Jawa Tengah",
      "Jawa Timur",
      "Yogyakarta",
      "Bali",
      "Sumatera Utara",
      "Sumatera Barat",
      "Sumatera Selatan",
      "Riau",
      "Jambi",
      "Lampung",
      "Bengkulu",
      "Kepulauan Riau",
      "Kalimantan Barat",
      "Kalimantan Timur",
      "Kalimantan Tengah",
      "Sulawesi Selatan",
      "Sulawesi Utara",
      "Sulawesi Tengah",
      "Sulawesi Tenggara",
      "Sulawesi Barat",
      "Maluku",
      "Maluku Utara",
      "Papua",
      "Nusa Tenggara Barat",
      "Nusa Tenggara Timur"
    )
    
    lokasi_regex <- paste(
      lokasi_list,
      collapse = "|"
    )
    
    location[i] <- str_extract(
      txt,
      lokasi_regex
    )
    
    
    # ==========================
    # SELLER TYPE
    # ==========================
    
    if (str_detect(txt, "\\bPrivate\\b")) {
      seller_type[i] <- "Private"
      
    } else if (str_detect(txt, "\\bDealer\\b")) {
      seller_type[i] <- "Dealer"
      
    } else {
      seller_type[i] <- NA_character_
    }
    
    
    # ==========================
    # URL
    # ==========================
    
    link <- container %>%
      html_element("a") %>%
      html_attr("href")
    
    if (!is.na(link) && length(link) > 0) {
      
      if (str_detect(link, "^/")) {
        link <- paste0(
          "https://www.carmudi.co.id",
          link
        )
      }
      
      listing_url[i] <- link
      
    } else {
      listing_url[i] <- NA_character_
    }
  }
  
  
  # ==============================
  # MASUKKAN HASIL
  # ==============================
  
  data$price <- price
  data$mileage <- mileage
  data$transmission <- transmission
  data$location <- location
  data$seller_type <- seller_type
  data$url <- listing_url
  
  
  # ==============================
  # BERSIHKAN TEXT
  # ==============================
  
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        where(is.character),
        ~ str_squish(.x)
      )
    )
  
  
  return(data)
}
```

```{r}
data_page1 <- scrape_page(1)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# SCRAPING 80 HALAMAN
# ==========================================

data_semua <- list()

for (i in 1:80) {
  
  hasil <- tryCatch(
    scrape_page(i),
    error = function(e) {
      cat(
        "ERROR halaman", i,
        ":", e$message, "\n"
      )
      return(data.frame())
    }
  )
  
  # Simpan kalau halaman berhasil mendapatkan data
  if (nrow(hasil) > 0) {
    data_semua[[length(data_semua) + 1]] <- hasil
  }
  
  # Jeda supaya website tidak terlalu cepat dibebani
  Sys.sleep(1)
}

# ==========================================
# GABUNGKAN SEMUA DATA
# ==========================================

data_mobil <- bind_rows(data_semua)

# Jumlah data
cat("TOTAL DATA:", nrow(data_mobil), "\n")

# Lihat data
head(data_mobil)

# Struktur data
str(data_mobil)
```

```{r}
data_final <- data_mobil %>%
  select(
    year,
    brand,
    model,
    price,
    mileage_clean,
    transmission,
    location,
    seller_type,
    url
  ) %>%
  rename(
    mileage = mileage_clean
  )
```
